Meta.title: Bind · DeFi protocol insurance on Stellar
Meta.description: Insurance DeFi protocols contract. Protected Deposit for users; claims settled under the hood. Built for Blend-like markets and wallets.
Meta.ogTitle: Bind · DeFi protocol insurance on Stellar
Meta.ogDescription: Retention-window cover for DeFi protocols. Protocols contract Bind; users get Protected Deposit.

Footer.blurb: DeFi security insurance on Stellar. Protocols contract Bind; depositors get a protected retention window and in-window claims.

Home.headline: Insurance for DeFi deposits.
Home.subhead: If someone takes your funds while they are still covered, Bind has your back.
Home.flowTitle: Cover your protocol buys, not an app users download.
Home.flowBody: Bind sits underneath as the insurance counterparty. You keep the product surface; we own policy, retention, and claims.
Home.flow1Body: Buy cover in basis points. Keep your money market and show Protected Deposit under your brand.
Home.flow2Body: Covered deposits sit in a timed window. Unwrap and swap stay blocked while unsettled.
Home.flow3Body: Approved claims pay on the Bind rail. Under the hood that uses Stellar clawback + remint (ops, not the consumer brand). Off-rail drains need Tier 3 capital.
Home.lanesTitle: Pay with time, or with KYC.
Home.lanesBody: Retention is deferred finality, a documented protected hold, not a mystery lock.
Home.standardBody: Default for every depositor. Longer hold without identity.
Home.fastBody: Partner-vetted KYC shortens the window and improves attacker attribution.
Home.ctaBody: Cover schedule in basis points, a written claims policy, and public proof of reserves. Integration in days, not a rebuild.

QuickDemo.body: Scroll to walk Deposit, the retention hold, then Settled or Claim.
QuickDemo.scrollHint: Scroll inside this window. No taps needed.
QuickDemo.s1Title: User wraps 100 USDC into Bind cover
QuickDemo.s1Body: Funds enter the Bind rail as covered credit. Your protocol still owns the money-market UX.
QuickDemo.s2Body: In production this is ~12h without KYC (or ~1h with Fast Lane). Here it compresses so you can feel the block.
QuickDemo.s3Title: Still inside the window: what happened?
QuickDemo.s3Body: No breach → wait to settle and unwrap 1:1. Breach on-rail → open a claim while funds cannot free-exit.
QuickDemo.s4SettleBody: Credit settles. User can unwrap to USDC. No claim needed. Peg stays vault ≥ supply.
QuickDemo.s4ClaimBody: Lot freezes. Claims desk reviews. Approved claim settles cover 1:1 to the rightful party. Clawback is ops under the hood, not the product pitch.

Cover.title: What Bind covers
Cover.body: Clear perils inside the retention window, and what stays out of scope.
Cover.coveredBody: Unauthorized movement of unsettled Bind credit (key theft, phishing, or mis-send) while the retention window is open, subject to caps and the claims policy.
Cover.not1: Partner protocol exploits, oracles, or bad debt
Cover.not3: Settled credit, unwrapped USDC, or value already swapped off-rail
Cover.capsMeta: Max lot 10,000 · max claim 10,000 · max 3 open claims per account · max unsettled supply 500,000

Integrate.card1Body: Your brand, your KYC, your market. Bind is the cover rail underneath.
Integrate.card2Body: Retention window, freeze and claim, indemnity, Exit Pool, and caps.

Docs.title: How Bind works
Docs.intro: Short guide for partners: what Protected Deposit is, what is claimable, and where to plug in.
Docs.linkCoverBody: What Bind covers, caps, and exclusions.
Docs.linkPolicyBody: Who can claim and how approve / reject works.
Docs.linkTermsBody: Demo terms. Recovery facility, not a bank.
Docs.linkIntegrateBody: Safe Deposit and API for protocols and wallets.
Docs.linkLiveBody: Sign real testnet vault transactions with Freighter.
Docs.assetBody: Deposit USDC → covered credit 1:1. A transfer creates an unsettled lot with window T. After T, settle → unwrap to USDC. Only unsettled lots are claimable.
Docs.inv3: Approved claims remint settled credit to the claimant
Docs.inv4: Caps on lot size, unsettled supply, and open claims
Docs.inv5: Production issuer / arbiter keys are multisig
Docs.clawbackBody: Clawback is claims ops under the hood, not the product brand. It only touches unsettled cover on an open claim path. Settled credit is final. Exit Pool lets users leave early for a fee.
Docs.exitBody: Sell unsettled cover for USDC immediately by paying a fee. That fee prices cover risk.
Docs.safeBody: For Blend-like markets: wrap → transfer into protocol custody as unsettled. You keep the money market; Bind covers the movement window.

Policy.title: Claims policy
Policy.body: Who can open a claim, what can be approved, and what stays out of scope.
Policy.introPerils: Perils and caps live in the
Policy.scopeBody: Only unsettled Bind credit inside the retention window. Settled credit and free USDC are final.
Policy.whoBody: The original sender of the lot. Partners may open on behalf of users in the partner phase.
Policy.approve: Freeze clears; settled credit remints to the claimant.
Policy.reject: Lot unfreezes; the settlement clock continues.
Policy.notBody: Settled or unwrapped funds, off-rail swaps, partner exploits, oracles, liquidations, and bad debt.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.body: Bind is an optional recovery and cover facility, not a bank, and not licensed insurance unless separately authorized.
Terms.li1: Cover only on unsettled lots inside the retention window.
Terms.li2: Clawback is the claims rail, not the consumer product.
Terms.li3: Partner protocol exploits and liquidations are excluded.
Terms.li4: Liability is limited to the vault and pool under the cover schedule.
